hash_chain.checkpoint_binding_note: The original formal status directly binds ONNX and predictions, not model.pt. This audit newly binds model.pt bytes and strictly verifies its payload lineage/epoch/metrics against that status.

metric_authority.boundary: This reproduces the repository formal validator on a frozen, hash-bound validation population. It is not the competition's official PinF1 and cannot close that release subgate.
metric_authority.reported_metric: repository-local anonymous Pin detection P/R/F1 at 4 input pixels

protocol.component_size_definition: area of the status/config bound component rectangle after ROI-to-384x384 model-input scaling; COCO-style 32^2/96^2 bins
protocol.matching: production maximum-cardinality one-to-one Euclidean matcher; retained deterministic assignments assert equal cardinality per view
protocol.target_level_attribution: matched prediction and TP use the matched GT group; unmatched GT uses its GT group; unmatched prediction uses its predicted group

runtime.device_contract: CPU checkpoint load plus JSON replay only

weak_group_definition.selection_role: fixed diagnostic definition; not a tuned model threshold
